episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Hank rants against Railton College, calling it "Mediocrity's Capitol," and the administration is pressured to fire him; Hank and Lily contemplate a future outside of Railton.

episodes.title: George Saunders
episodes.summary: When George Saunders visits Railton College, the professors scramble to impress the celebrated writer, while Hank is reminded of his own failed writing career; Hank and Lily anticipate an announcement from their daughter Julie.

episodes.title: Escape
episodes.summary: Hank spirals when a storage pod full of his father's belongings is dropped in his front yard; the professors spiral when rumors of budget cuts threaten their tenured jobs.

episodes.title: The Goose Boxer
episodes.summary: Amid firing rumors, the professors look to the union to protect their jobs, while Hank tries a different approach. Lily interviews for a job at a prestigious New York prep school.

episodes.title: The Clock
episodes.summary: Hank and Lily host the annual English department dinner; Lily has a decision to make; Hank's past involving his troubled relationship with his father catches up to him.

episodes.title: The Arrival
episodes.summary: Hank and Tony travel to an academic conference, where their differing philosophies on work and life cause friction; Lily mediates trouble in Julie and Russell's marriage.

episodes.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
episodes.summary: Hank contends with the return of his father to Railton; Lily hunts for apartments in New York; Julie looks to Hank for help in Lily's absence.

episodes.title: The Chopping Block
episodes.summary: Hank is faced with an impossible decision at work, as his department's jobs are on the line; Lily settles into a new normal in New York.
